C0926.title: Quanzhou Police Alert: Lottery Scams Among 10 Fraud Types Surging After Holidays
C0926.summary: In February 2023, the Quanzhou Anti-Fraud Center issued a post-holiday fraud prevention guide covering ten common scams, including impersonating customer service, online order brushing, and impersonating acquaintances. The guide warned that post-holiday job seeking, online shopping, social communication, and fund transfer scenarios are easily exploited by scammers, and users should verify identities, watch for unfamiliar links and transfer requests, and avoid phishing or induced-payment traps.
